# Anne Shirley & Marilla Cuthbert

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) — dear friends who let her stay at Green Gables · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P30](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P27](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0027)</sub>
- [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) — Mentor of — [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P27](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0027), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P0](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0000)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) brings [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home, where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) expresses shock upon discovering she is a girl rather than the expected boy. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) breaks down in tears when she realizes she is not wanted, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) allows her to stay overnight in the east gable room. After putting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to bed, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) insists on sending her back, while [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) gently suggests they might keep her.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P39](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and admires the surrounding landscape from her window before being told by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to dress and come down for breakfast. After eating with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and a quiet [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) washes the dishes and names Marilla's geranium Bonny. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) then prepares to drive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) over to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) to settle her return arrangements.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P1](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P8](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P19](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P27](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0027)_

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visit Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md) to clarify the adoption mix-up, where Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md) offers to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in as a servant. Seeing Anne's distress and disliking Mrs. Blewett's harsh nature, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) hesitates and decides to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back home to consult [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). Later at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay with them, resolving to raise her properly.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P12](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER VI. > [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to bed and instructs her on neatness and saying bedtime prayers. After finding out [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has never prayed, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) has her improvise a prayer, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) recites in an unorthodox manner. Afterwards, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) goes down to the kitchen and complains to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) about Anne's lack of religious upbringing, resolving to educate her.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P1](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P4](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER VII. > [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) have decided to let her stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) then instructs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to learn the Lord's Prayer, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) repeatedly gets distracted by her daydreams and imaginations. Eventually, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is sent to her bedroom where she finishes learning the prayer and continues daydreaming out her window.
>

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to meet [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), but offends her with blunt remarks about her red hair and looks. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flies into a fiery rage, shouting at Mrs. Lynde before storming off to her bedroom. After Mrs. Lynde leaves in huff, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) upstairs and orders her to remain in her room until she agrees to apologize.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) secretly visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room and persuades her to apologize to Mrs. Lynde so she can leave her punishment. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dramatically apologizes to Mrs. Lynde, who forgives her completely and gives her flowers. As [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walk back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels a warm surge of affection for the girl despite her theatrical nature.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) presents [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with three plain new dresses, to Anne's disappointment over their lack of puffed sleeves. The following morning, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) stays home sick while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decorates her hat with flowers and attends Sunday-school alone, where she feels out of place in Miss Rogerson's class. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gives [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) a candid review of her day, the lesson, and the church service.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to meet [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) and her mother. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) quickly become friends in the garden, solemnly swearing eternal friendship. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) joyfully tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her new friend, and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) surprises [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with a gift of chocolate sweeties.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns about an upcoming Sunday-school picnic and excitedly asks [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) for permission to attend. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees to bake her a picnic basket, prompting a rare, affectionate embrace from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). As [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) works on her sewing, she chatteringly details her playhouse, [Idlewild](../codex/places.md#idlewild), and her growing excitement for the picnic.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) accuses [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) of losing her amethyst brooch and confines her to her room until she confesses. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) concocts a false confession in hopes of being allowed to go to the Sunday school picnic, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) still forbids her from going. However, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) soon discovers the brooch snagged in her lace shawl, apologizes to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and sends her off to enjoy the picnic.
>

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home overjoyed by the day's excitement and ice cream, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) later recounts the whole incident to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) by being forced to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) after being late to school. Humiliated, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to quit school entirely. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she cools off.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) permission to invite [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) over for tea and raspberry cordial while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) attends a meeting. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) unintentionally serves [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) three glasses of home-made currant wine instead of cordial, causing [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to become intoxicated and sick. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns from Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) via Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) that she accidentally got [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drunk and is banned from seeing her.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tearfully explains to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that she accidentally served [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, leading Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) to ban [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) from playing with her. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to clear up the mistake, but Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) refuses to listen. Desperate, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) herself to plead for forgiveness, but is coldly turned away.
>

> While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Lynde attend a political rally in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) stay home at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes in desperately seeking help for her sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), who has severe croup. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully treats [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) during the night, earning Mrs. Barry's gratitude and restoring her friendship with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
>

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) excitedly runs over to the [Barry](../character/barry.md) house and later returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to tell [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about their joyful reconciliation and evening together.

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attend a concert and sleep over at Diana's house. After enjoying the concert with their classmates, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) race into the spare-room bed at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), unaware that Diana's [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) is sleeping in it. The surprise causes [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) to react angrily, threatening to cut short her visit and cancel Diana's music lessons until [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to take responsibility.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) admits her fault to Mrs. Lynde before walking over to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to apologize directly to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). Anne's brave and earnest explanation amuses [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), who decides to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and continue Diana's music lessons. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) become great friends during her month-long stay.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on the past year since arriving at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and recounts her imaginative adventures to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) asks her to run an errand to the Barrys' house, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) confesses she is terrified of crossing the spruce grove because she and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) imagined it was a haunted wood. To break her of this silly fear, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) insists that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walk through the dark woods anyway, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) does in sheer terror before returning safely.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home on the last day of school, emotional after Mr. Phillips's farewell speech and eager about the arrival of Avonlea's new minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his wife. [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) prepares to host the new minister and his wife for tea, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) making a layer cake for Mrs. Allan. However, during the tea party, Mrs. Allan and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notice a strange taste in Anne's cake.
>

> During tea with Mr. and Mrs. Allan, Anne's homemade cake is discovered to have been accidentally flavored with anodyne liniment instead of vanilla. Mortified, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flees to her room, but Mrs. Allan kindly comforts her and invites her to show off her flower garden. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects optimistically to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that tomorrow is a new day free of mistakes.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comes home thrilled to receive an invitation to tea at the manse from Mrs. Allan. After worrying about her conduct, she returns from the visit in high spirits and happily recounts the evening to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), including news that [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) has hired a new female schoolteacher.
>

> At a party, [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) dares [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof, leading to a fall that breaks Anne's ankle. Mr. [Barry](../character/barry.md) carries [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to realize how deeply she cares for the girl. During her seven weeks of bed rest, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is comforted by visitors, reflects on her mistakes, and looks forward to returning to school to meet her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and flourishes under her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) organizes a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert to raise money for a school flag, throwing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and the other students into excited preparations despite Marilla's skepticism. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her upcoming concert roles with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), finding steady support and encouragement in [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>

On [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overjoyed to receive the stylish dress from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) as well as a pair of slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). She later wears her new outfit to the school concert, where she performs brilliantly.
>

They participate in the evening concert, which is a great success, and walk home together discussing the performances. Afterward, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sit by the fire and express their pride in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), briefly discussing her future education.

> On her thirteenth birthday, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks to school with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) down the [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path), discussing their growing up and Anne's melodramatic composition assignment. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) proposes starting a story club, which quickly expands to include other schoolmates. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses the club and its moral lessons with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends re-enact the story of [Elaine](../character/elaine.md), floating [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) down the pond in a leaky boat. After the boat sinks, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) clings to a bridge pile until [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rescues her, though she refuses his offer of friendship. Back home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on learning not to be overly romantic, but [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) gently encourages her to keep a bit of romance in her life.

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visit [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). The girls enjoy their scenic evening drive back to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) welcome her home with a hot supper.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) wants to prepare her for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) agree to pay for the extra schooling, which fulfills a dream for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later joins the newly formed Queen's class at school alongside her classmates, though she feels saddened that [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) will not be joining them.
>

>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys a restful, active summer outdoors on the [Spencervale](../codex/places.md#spencervale) doctor's orders before returning to her studies in autumn. As the school year progresses, she prepares intensely for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams under Miss Stacy's guidance. Meanwhile, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) observes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) growing up into a quieter, taller young woman and privately grieves the passing of Anne's childhood.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) anxiously awaits the results of the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes over to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the newspaper showing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the [Island](../codex/places.md#island) with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares the joyful news with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. Lynde before going to sleep feeling grateful.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), assisted by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and checked by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). After driving over with [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) experiences severe stage fright on the hotel platform, but recovers upon seeing [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the crowd and performs brilliantly to enthusiastic applause.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) with help from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), who grows emotional reflecting on how much [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) means to them. Upon arriving in town, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) adjusts to her new living arrangements and classes, feeling a mix of rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and homesickness. Her spirits are lifted when [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and Ruby visit, bringing news that Queen's will award an Avery scholarship to [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) suddenly collapses and dies after reading a notice about the failure of the Abbey Bank. After his funeral, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comfort each other in their shared grief. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talks with Mrs. Allan about finding moments of joy amidst her sorrow, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reflects on her past romantic history with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's father.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns from the oculist with news that her failing eyesight will force her to sell [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to let her sell, giving up her college scholarship to stay home, teach, and care for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Mrs. Lynde later reveals that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gave up the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could teach close to home, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reconcile with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and become close friends.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is interrupted while studying on her doorstep by her angry new neighbor, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), whose oatfield was invaded by Anne's cow. After arguing with him, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) pens the cow up and later discusses the incident and village gossip over tea with [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>

> Mrs. Lynde expresses her skepticism about [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's son coming to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), as well as Anne's plans to start a Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Despite Mrs. Lynde's warning that people dislike being improved, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) remains determined to pursue the idea alongside [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Mrs. Lynde also shares that Anne's friend [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) has been hired to teach at [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) plans on their drive home from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) when they spot a Jersey cow trampling Mr. Harrison's oat field. Believing the cow is her own nuisance Jersey, [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) impulsively sells the stray cow on the spot to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md) for twenty dollars. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers [Dolly](../character/dolly.md) still in the barnyard and realizes she accidentally sold Mr. Harrison's cow, prompting her to head over to his house with the money and a cake to confess.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to Mr. Harrison's home to confess that she accidentally sold his Jersey cow, but he receives the news calmly, insults from his parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md) notwithstanding. After trading cows and sharing tea and cake, the two form an unexpected friendship. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home relieved and shares the outcome with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) debate the ethics and effectiveness of corporal punishment in school teaching on the eve of the school year. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) then visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who also doubts her plan to rule by affection rather than the rod, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) anxious about her upcoming first day of teaching.
>
> — v2 · IV Different Opinions

_Sources: [v2 IV Different Opinions P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 IV Different Opinions P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007), [v2 IV Different Opinions P35](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0035), [v2 IV Different Opinions P41](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0041)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss the newly formed [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) as they drive through the countryside to canvass for hall repairs. They visit several local residents, dealing with the pessimistic Miss [Eliza](../character/eliza-andrews.md), receiving a secret donation from Catherine, helping Dan Blair mix a cake, and navigating Mrs. Theodore White's extreme cleanliness to gather subscriptions.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P12](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0012), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P36](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0036)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) chat at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) about their teaching experiences and future aspirations. After [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaves, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home tired and reveals that her sick relative [Mary](../character/mary-joe.md) Keith cannot care for her twins much longer. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) convinces a hesitant [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to take in the Keith twins out of a sense of duty.
>
> — v2 · VII The Pointing of Duty

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P1](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0001), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P12](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0012), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P23](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0023), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P33](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0033)_

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) brings the twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) Keith, home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) quickly displays his mischievous and unruly nature. Over the next few days, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) causes trouble by dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck at church, making [Dora](../character/dora.md) fall into a pigpen, and hiding a toad in Marilla's bed.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) debate Mrs. Lynde's virtues and discuss the village hall painting project. Later, [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) paints the hall a bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with paint numbers, causing dismay among the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Despite the hideous result, public sympathy turns in favor of the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), and the community rallies around them.
>

> After walking home from school, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) panicking because [Dora](../character/dora.md) is missing, and the household fears she may have fallen into the well. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers [Dora](../character/dora.md) locked in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse and realizes [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) hid her and lied about it. When confronted, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) tearfully apologizes after realizing lying hurts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to forgive his deceit while punishing him for the prank.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) lectures [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) about his behavior after he admits to skipping his prayers to test Marilla's warning. Later downstairs, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) laugh over the situation and discuss their difficulties and fondness for [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) despite his antics.
>

> In a bad mood from a toothache, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally causes fireworks to explode in the schoolroom and subsequently whips [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) after he puts a mouse in her desk. She goes home heartbroken over her bad day, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comforts her. The next morning, Anthony treats [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with new respect, and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) later confirms that the whipping gained his approval.
>

> Mrs. Lynde tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about preparations for the Ladies' [Aid](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) bazaar and asks to borrow Miss Barry's platter, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns Marilla's sight is improving. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) receives a letter from the twins' uncle extending their stay, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) remembers a conversation with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) after catching him eating plum jam. Later, at an Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting, [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) announces that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence to a medicine company for painted ads, prompting a committee of girls to try unsuccessfully to talk him out of it.
>

> [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) talks to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about his funny ideas about heaven until [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) arrive from the garden. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) then shares the exciting news from Priscilla's letter that author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) will be visiting [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for dinner, and she immediately begins planning the meal and preparations.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) frantically decorate [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and prepare a elaborate dinner for the arrival of the famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md). However, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) accidentally destroys the lemon pies, the guest of honor fails to arrive, and a series of mishaps ruins the meal and results in Miss Barry's expensive platter being broken. A later letter reveals Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprained her ankle, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reflect on her bitter disappointment.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

> After the guests depart, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns via a letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) will not be visiting [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) due to a sprained ankle. Sitting on the porch at twilight, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Anne's tendency toward high hopes and deep disappointments, how to replace Aunt Josephine's broken platter, and neighborhood gossip about Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md).
>

> [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) questions [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about where sleep goes before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) alerts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to Diana's signal fire. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to Diana's house and learns about a potential willow-ware platter at the Copp place in [Spencervale](../codex/places.md#spencervale). The next day, the girls travel to [Spencervale](../codex/places.md#spencervale), where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally breaks through the roof of an outhouse while peeping through a window to inspect the platter, trapping herself until Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp returns and chops her free.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) for tea while his grandmother is away, reassuring him about his imaginative ideas. She returns home to handle [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) before bedtime and then encounters [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) by the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble).
>

> [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) boasts to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about being good by sharing his jam bread with [Dora](../character/dora.md) before kneeling to say his prayers. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later meets [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) by Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), where they discuss the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Improvement Society's progress and school developments. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talks with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her busy schedule for the next day.
>

> While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is away, [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) unexpectedly arrives at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), covered in feathers and having accidentally dyed her nose red, quickly cleans herself up. With help from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hosts a successful and delightful visit for her distinguished guests.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to teaching school, where [Dora](../character/dora.md) is frightened by [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) Cotton's stories about a ghost relative. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk through the woods to go to [West Grafton](../codex/places.md#west-grafton), but lose their way and discover [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), the quaint stone home of Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her young helper, Charlotta the Fourth. Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) warmly invites them to stay for a imaginary tea party she had set up to combat loneliness.
>

> At the breakfast table, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Anne's visit with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and gossip about old town affairs while trying to keep [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) in check. Later, word arrives that [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md) has died and left money in trust for the twins, ensuring that [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) can remain living at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) permanently.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) on a wintry evening, and over tea and candy, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) recounts her long-ago romance and quarrel with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). A month later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) introduces Stephen's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), and the two immediately form a fond friendship during their visit.
>

> Uncle Abe's storm prediction comes true with violent force, bringing a devastating hail storm to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and the twins rush home from school as [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) suffers broken windows and stripped vegetation. The storm kills Mr. Harrison's parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md) and ruins local crops and young trees, though [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) find solace in the fact that Mr. Boulter's unsightly old house burned down.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learn that Mr. Harrison's long-estranged wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), has arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after seeing a newspaper joke about his supposed remarriage. Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) investigates the situation, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to hear his side of the story.
>

> Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) explains to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) how he and his wife [Emily](../character/emily.md) separated in the past over household neatness, grammar nagging, and his parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md). [Emily](../character/emily.md) returns from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) with Mrs. Lynde, welcomes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) radiantly, and later admits her own past foolishness as she walks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home. Back at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), Mrs. Lynde comments on the situation before leaving, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) puts a sleepy [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed.
>

> The A.V.I.S. throws a farewell party for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) before they leave for college, though Anne's evening is somewhat ruined by Gilbert's sentimentality and Charlie Sloane's dull company. The next day, after dealing with discouraging goodbyes from local women, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes for a peaceful evening walk in the woods with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), restoring her spirits.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) on a rainy morning after tearful goodbyes and travels by train and boat to [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and Charlie. Upon arriving, she is warmly greeted by [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), who whisks her away to their new boardinghouse and helps lift her homesick spirits.
>
> — v3 · Chapter III Greeting and Farewell

_Sources: [v3 ch.Farewell P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002), [v3 ch.Farewell P4](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0004), [v3 ch.Farewell P10](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0010), [v3 ch.Farewell P24](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0024)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes her term at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holidays. Upon her arrival, she receives a enthusiastic welcome from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Lynde, [Dora](../character/dora.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), who builds a bonfire for her. Before bed, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) work through his guilt over wanting to use a bad word he heard from a hired boy.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VII Home Again

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P12](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0012), [v3 ch.Again P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016), [v3 ch.Again P18](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0018), [v3 ch.Again P34](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0034)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends an evening with a dying [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), who tearfully confesses her fear of death and her unfulfilled dreams. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) offers quiet comfort, and Ruby passes away peacefully in her sleep the following night. After the funeral, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects deeply on life and mortality while walking home with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a snowbound [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holiday and finds Gilbert's visits increasingly uncomfortable. She worries about being able to afford her next year at college until she receives a letter announcing a thousand-dollar legacy from the late Miss Josephine Barry.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sits reminiscing by the fire at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrives home early from college, surprising her warmly. They chat about Anne's walk and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) before [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) bursts in, excitedly telling [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about his missing tooth and his thoughts on marriage.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXII Spring and Anne Return to Green Gables

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gables P0](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0000), [v3 ch.Gables P4](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0004), [v3 ch.Gables P5](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0005), [v3 ch.Gables P17](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0017)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) joins [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel, [Dora](../character/dora.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) outside [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) on a June evening. After cheering up [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) regarding his schoolwork, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) listens to Mrs. Rachel talk about Aunt Atossa's funeral and Diana's upcoming wedding. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later wanders down to the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), reflecting mournfully on growing up, losing Diana's close companionship, and her strained dynamic with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) prepare for her wedding, reminiscing about their childhood vows of friendship and future plans. [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) arrives to walk [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) into the parlor for the ceremony and then accompanies her back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) afterwards, taking a moonlight stroll through Lovers' Lane.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIX Diana’s Wedding

_Sources: [v3 ch.Wedding P1](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0001), [v3 ch.Wedding P4](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0004), [v3 ch.Wedding P12](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0012), [v3 ch.Wedding P13](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0013)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) feeling disillusioned after rejecting [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), but learns from [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) that he recovers quickly from heartbreak. She hears [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) gossip from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Lynde, clashes with Mrs. [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md) over Jane's lavish engagement, and attends Phil's wedding in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke). Back in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and her newborn baby, feeling increasingly lonely as her friends move on into new stages of life.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIX Deals with Weddings

> At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discuss [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Gilbert's upcoming wedding and the gifts they plan to give. Neighbors visit to offer mixed congratulations, after which [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) joins [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to share details about the house he has found for them near [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds).
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) host their first [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) dinner at their new home in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), welcoming [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), Captain Jim, and Miss Cornelia. The guests enjoy lively conversation and stories before Captain Jim heads back to the lighthouse at sunset.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes into labor and gives birth to a baby girl, whom she and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) name Joyce. However, the baby dies shortly after birth, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) heartbroken and struggling through a painful recovery.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gives birth to a healthy baby boy, bringing immense joy and relief to the household after her previous loss. They decide to name the boy [James Matthew](../character/james-matthew.md), and the friends and family visit to admire the newborn while Miss Cornelia and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discuss Owen Ford's upcoming visit.
